description: This file contains functions and scripts related to analyzing behavioral transition matrices, generating GraphViz code, and creating visual diagrams from transition data within the BORIS behavioral observation software. It includes functions for processing behavioral sequences, creating transition matrices, and integrating with GraphViz for visualization.

methods.name: behavioral_strings_analysis
methods.description: Analyzes behavioral strings to extract sequences and unique behaviors.

methods.name: observed_transitions_matrix
methods.description: Creates a normalized transition matrix from sequences and behaviors, mode-dependent.

methods.name: create_transitions_gv_from_matrix
methods.description: Generates GraphViz code for a transition matrix, with cutoff options.

methods.name: transitions_matrix
methods.description: Creates transition frequency matrices based on user-selected observations and behaviors.

methods.name: transitions_dot_script
methods.description: Creates GraphViz dot scripts from transition matrices files.

methods.name: transitions_flow_diagram
methods.description: Creates flow diagrams using GraphViz from transition matrices, checking for GraphViz installation.
